payments-bot: Alert: charge attempt failed for INV-5233 (decline code: card_declined). Attempt 1.

erin_finance: Noted - BigPixel Labs renewal. I emailed billing contact earlier this morning.

josh_support: Customer replied in the support ticket: their card was flagged by bank. They want to do ACH today. Asked for ACH instructions and whether we can recon once ACH is initiated.

erin_finance: We can accept ACH but we do not mark invoice paid until settlement. Pause dunning and auto-cancel for 48h. @rita_accounting can you pause the automated notices?

rita_accounting: Pausing dunning 48h and setting invoice flag to "pending - ACH". When they paste the bank confirmation (ACH trace or bank receipt + amount) I'll reconcile.

mai_sales: AM said they'll initiate ACH if we send a copy/paste template. Also asked if we can provision service while ACH is in flight 
erin_finance: If sales signs off we can provision. Use this ACH template (mask account):

```
Bank: Union Coast Bank
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Account: ****5599
Routing (ACH/ABA): 555000666
Account type: Checking
Memo: INV-5233
Amount: USD 27,500.00
```

josh_support: Sent template to customer at 13:07 PT and asked them to reply here with bank confirmation once initiated. Included invoice link: https://invoices.redwood.ai/INV-5233

erin_finance: Scheduling one automatic retry for 24h in case they update card. If ACH confirmation arrives first I'll cancel the retry.

payments-bot: Scheduled retry set for 1747087634 (24h).

rita_accounting: When ACH posts paste the bank's trace id + posted date here and I'll apply payment. If partial ACH arrives, we'll hold until full unless AM approves partial credit.

mai_sales: I'll follow up with AM and cc accounting on the confirmation. If no ACH by EOD +2 escalate to collections.
